notes: pokemon ids: first form tab of a page uses the page slug; other forms are <page>-<form-slug>. pokemonAliases maps site links like 'muk-normal' or 'aegislash-shield' to the entry id.
move ids are kebab slugs of the move name (site convention for items/abilities); moves[].code is the site's move file name (e.g. CALMMIND).
locations[].rate is a percentage; the site's fractional rates are rounded to 2 decimals.

itemSources.name: Pokémon Reborn Wiki (Fandom)
itemSources.attribution: Item, TM and key item locations and the Pickup table are adapted from the Pokémon Reborn Wiki on Fandom (pokemon-reborn.fandom.com), by its contributors, under CC BY-SA 3.0. Each location row names the wiki page it came from in 'source'.
itemSources.caveat: The wiki is community-maintained and may describe a different game version than the v19.16 game data; rows are taken as written.
